REASON: The reviewer correctly identifies the fatal flaw that hashing by merchant ID will send 35% of write volume (3,150 writes/sec) to a single shard, exceeding its 1,000 writes/sec capacity, and treats it as a critical issue requiring a redesign. The recommendation is to revise and resubmit ("Do Not Approve in Current Form", "Required Actions Before Approval"), not to abandon the proposal entirely, so it is blocked but not killed.

FLAW_CAUGHT: 1
KILLED: 0
BLOCKED: 1
